 Hon'Ble Abdul Shahid, J.

Heard learned counsel for the revisionist, learned counsel for the opposite party nos. 2 to 6 and learned AGA for the State.
The present revision has been filed with the prayer to set aside the impugned order dated 30.09.2024 passed by learned Additional Session Judge, Court No. 14, Bareilly in Criminal Revision No. 39/2024, under Sections 452, 406, 504 IPC, P.S. Hafizganj, District Bareilly, whereby the learned Court of Additional Session Judge, Court No. 14, Bareilly, set aside the summoning order dated 10.04.2023 passed by the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-III, Bareilly in complaint no. 5137 of 2021 filed by the revisionist.

entities.text: Court of Additional Session Judge, Court No. 14, Bareilly
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the revisionist has submitted that the impugned order dated 30.09.2024 is having illegality and irregularity.
There is no concealment of fact.
The notice has been issued by the Magistrate Court against the revisionist.
The revisionist/accused party has having all the opportunity to defend themselves.
Learned counsel for the opposite party nos. 2 to 6 has submitted that there is no illegality or irregularity in the impugned order.
He further submitted that the learned trial court has clearly framed the further question which should be asked to the complainant in recording of his statement u/s 200 Cr.P.C.

Learned counsel for the revisionist has submitted that he filed a complaint on 13.02.2020 whereas the case crime no. 89/2020 under Section 376, 313, 506 IPC filed by opposite party no. 5, Km.
Mehnaz on 15.02.2020.
The FIR was lodged after the filing of the complaint hence, there is no question arose of referring the said FIR in his complaint dated 13.02.2020.
The impugned order has been passed by the revisional Court who has to simply look into the matter, that what are the illegality or irregularity committed by the court below.
There is no legal necessity of complete appreciation of the facts.
It is the matter of trial.
The framing of all the questions by the learned court below in the criminal revision that, what question should be asked is beyond their jurisdiction.

In view thereof, the impugned order dated 30.09.2024 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Court No. 14, Bareilly in Criminal Revision No. 39/2024 (Iqbal Mohd. and Others Vs. State of U.P. and Another) is hereby set aside.
